SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman, how are you feeling today?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 宥万先生，今天状态怎么样？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 宥萬先生，今天的狀況如何？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん 今日のコンディションはいかがですか?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Como o senhor está se sentindo hoje, senhor Yuman?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hi! It was nice—finally got to sleep at home again.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 您好，隔了这么久在家睡觉，感觉特别好
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你好。好久沒有回家裡睡，狀態很好
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: こんにちは 久しぶりに家で寝たら気持ちよかったです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hai! Enak banget—akhirnya bisa tidur di rumah lagi.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Boa tarde. Ah, dormir na minha cama depois de tanto tempo foi ótimo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Buenas tardes. Pues dormir en mi cama después de tanto tiempo se sintió genial.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سلام! خوب بود - بالاخره دوباره در خونه بخوابم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: That’s great. We’ll remove the leg cast today.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 太好了，腿上的石膏今天可以给您拆掉了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 太好了，腿上的石膏今天可以拆除了喔
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: いいですね じゃあ今日は足のギプスを外しましょう
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Bagus deh. Hari ini kita bakal lepas gips kaki kamu.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Que bom. Então hoje eu vou tirar o gesso da sua perna.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Qué bien. Entonces hoy le voy a quitar el yeso de la pierna.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این عالی است امروز گچ پا را برمی داریم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yep~ Your bone healed up nicely.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯~因为骨头愈合得很好
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 是的～因為骨頭長得很好
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい 骨がきれいにくっつきましたから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya~ Tulangnya udah nyatu dengan baik.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim~ o osso cicatrizou muito bem.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Sí~ el hueso sanó muy bien.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بله ~ استخوان شما به خوبی بهبود یافت.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어? 머리에 뭐가 붙어있는 거 같은데...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hmm? You’ve got something in your hair...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 呃？头上好像沾了什么东西...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 欸？您頭上好像黏了什麼東西…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あれ? 髪に何かついてますよ…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Hmm? Ada sesuatu di rambut kamu...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã? Tem algo no seu cabelo...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هوم؟ یه چیزی تو موهات داری...
